original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Reduce repeated JSON serialization in the nine-stage PR589 hosted-instruction digest, retaining the full hosted audit.
scope_change_reason: The broad replay-runtime card is narrowed to the measured digest bottleneck in one pinned retained bit fixture.
bottleneck_link: The selected bit lineage uses this hosted ownership audit; faster exact hashing reduces the cost of replaying that finite check without changing its mathematical coverage.
stop_rule: One profiled fixture, one fragment-encoding implementation, bounded differential and failure controls, then package and publish. Stop if exact receipts or inherited rejection coverage differ.
evidence: BENCHMARK.json: same-fixture baseline/adapter digest and full audit; identical full receipts and 16 inherited rejected mutations; 120 byte-stream comparisons and 10 changed-input controls.

open_questions.question: Should the adapter be wired into an actively maintained cold-replay driver?

open_questions.blocked_by: Integration is outside this contribution and must preserve the driver source pins and applicable cold-replay obligations.
